title: Claim
description: One proposed claim or interpretation linking a finding, test, or drug to a hypothesis or case. See docs/INTERFACES.md and docs/08-verification.md.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier for the claim, e.g. c-0031

encounter_id.description: Encounter ID this claim belongs to, e.g. ENC000001

type.description: Type of claim to be verified

finding_id.description: The finding being linked or interpreted, e.g. f-0007

hypothesis_id.description: The candidate diagnosis being linked, e.g. h-dengue

proposed_by.description: Component or prompt that produced this claim, e.g. proposer@llm-A:prompt-v3 or kb-lookup@0.1.0

round.description: Reasoning round in which this claim was proposed
